external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A library member who uses the library app and self-service kiosk.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

external_entities.name: desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk staff who perform manual loan and account operations.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand
external_entities.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login for the circulation page.

processes.name: library app
processes.description: A phone application through which members borrow, renew and reserve books and which calls the lending API.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: self-service kiosk
processes.description: A branch kiosk where members scan their library card and books and which sends loans and returns to the lending API.
processes.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.

processes.name: lending API
processes.description: The REST API that applies loan rules and is the interface for loan and reservation activity and access to the loans database.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: The Lending service note says: "The lending API is internal-only." The Interview transcript says: "The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet." Authentication is uncertain: Priya said, "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look."

data_stores.name: loans database
data_stores.description: The database containing members, loans, reservations, names, email addresses, home addresses and full borrowing histories.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.
data_stores.notes: Priya corrected the earlier statement about two databases: "We merged those in the spring. It's one loans database now. The old reservations database is gone."

data_flows.name: use app
data_flows.description: A member uses the library app to borrow, renew or reserve books.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.
data_flows.data_description: Borrow, renewal and reservation requests involving members and books.

data_flows.name: change loans
data_flows.description: The library app calls the lending API with member and book or title details for borrowing, renewing or reserving.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member, and the API checks the loan rules and writes the change.
data_flows.data_description: Member and book or title details, plus loan and reservation changes.

data_flows.name: scan books
data_flows.description: A member scans a library card and books at a self-service kiosk.
data_flows.source_excerpt: a member scans their library card and the books they are borrowing or returning
data_flows.data_description: A library card and books being borrowed or returned.

data_flows.name: send loans
data_flows.description: The self-service kiosk sends each loan and return to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks send each loan and each return to the lending API.
data_flows.notes: Priya could not say what the kiosks talk to apart from what arrives at the API.
data_flows.data_description: Loans and returns scanned at the kiosk.

data_flows.name: manage loans
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page served by the lending API to extend loans, clear account blocks and mark books returned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login for the circulation page.
data_flows.data_description: Loan extensions, member account blocks and manual returns.

data_flows.name: read-write loans
data_flows.description: The lending API reads and writes the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: Members, loans, reservations and member borrowing history.

trust_boundaries.name: branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network on which the self-service kiosks and desk staff operate.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data centre where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

trust_boundaries.name: phones
trust_boundaries.description: The phones on which members use the library app.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

assumptions.assumption: The phones are a tenant-controlled device zone separate from the council-operated service.
assumptions.basis: The library app runs on members' phones, which are customers' own devices.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: The database contains names, email addresses, home addresses and members' full borrowing histories.
